description:
Fueled by a twisted transcendent intellect, the mononoke Amagi is a cold and cruel cynic who lives by the motto, "the weak are meat; the strong do eat." As a long-time enemy of the Bureau of Espionage, Amagi seeks to wipe out the organization for good, recruiting from far and wide like-minded sympathizers of his anti-human agenda.
Source: Official page
name: Amagi
